{"command":"python3 - << 'EOF'
import json
import numpy as np
import trimesh
import manifold3d
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

def trimesh_to_manifold(mesh):
    return manifold3d.Manifold(
        manifold3d.Mesh(
            vert_properties=np.asarray(mesh.vertices, dtype=np.float32),
            tri_verts=np.asarray(mesh.faces, dtype=np.uint32)
        )
    )

def intersection_volume(m1, m2):
    inter = trimesh_to_manifold(m1) ^ trimesh_to_manifold(m2)
    return inter.volume()

def min_surface_distance(m1, m2, n_samples=40000):
    pts1, _ = trimesh.sample.sample_surface(m1, n_samples)
    pts2, _ = trimesh.sample.sample_surface(m2, n_samples)
    pts1 = np.vstack([pts1, m1.vertices])
    pts2 = np.vstack([pts2, m2.vertices])
    tree1 = cKDTree(pts1)
    dists, _ = tree1.query(pts2, k=1)
    return float(np.min(dists))

with open("/app/output/joints.json", "r") as f:
    jdata = json.load(f)

full_mesh = trimesh.load("/app/output/model.stl", force="mesh")
parts = []
for pinfo in jdata["parts"]:
    pm = trimesh.load("/app/output/" + pinfo["file"], force="mesh")
    parts.append(pm)

print("=== 1. MESH TOPOLOGY & WATERTIGHTNESS ===")
print(f"model.stl: watertight={full_mesh.is_watertight}, body_count={full_mesh.body_count}, volume={full_mesh.volume:.2f} mm^3")
bbox = full_mesh.bounds
extents = full_mesh.extents
print(f"model.stl bounds: min={bbox[0].round(3)}, max={bbox[1].round(3)}")
print(f"model.stl extents (X x Y x Z): {extents[0]:.3f} x {extents[1]:.3f} x {extents[2]:.3f} mm (Limit: 160 x 50 x 40 mm)")
assert full_mesh.is_watertight, "model.stl is not watertight!"
assert full_mesh.body_count == 6, f"Expected 6 bodies in model.stl, got {full_mesh.body_count}"
assert extents[0] <= 160.0 and extents[1] <= 50.0 and extents[2] <= 40.0, "Bounding box exceeded limit!"

sum_vol = 0.0
for idx, pm in enumerate(parts, 1):
    z_min, z_max = pm.bounds[0][2], pm.bounds[1][2]
    face_z = pm.triangles_center[:, 2]
    bed_faces = (face_z < 0.02) & (pm.face_normals[:, 2] < -0.95)
    bed_area = float(np.sum(pm.area_faces[bed_faces]))
    print(f"parts_{idx}.stl: watertight={pm.is_watertight}, bodies={pm.body_count}, vol={pm.volume:.2f} mm^3, Z=[{z_min:.3f}, {z_max:.3f}], bed_area={bed_area:.1f} mm^2")
    assert pm.is_watertight and pm.body_count == 1
    assert abs(z_min) < 1e-4 and bed_area > 50.0
    sum_vol += pm.volume

print(f"Total parts volume = {sum_vol:.2f} mm^3, diff from model.stl = {abs(sum_vol - full_mesh.volume):.5f} mm^3")

print("\n=== 2. NEUTRAL POSE CLEARANCE & RADIAL GAP CHECK ===")
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    ivol = intersection_volume(pa, pb)
    mdist = min_surface_distance(pa, pb)
    jx, jy, jz = jinfo["position"]
    sec_a = pa.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    sec_b = pb.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    pts_a = sec_a.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])
    pts_b = sec_b.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])
    ra = np.linalg.norm(pts_a, axis=1)
    rb = np.linalg.norm(pts_b, axis=1)
    r_shaft = jinfo["pin_shaft_radius"]
    pin_r_meas = np.median(ra[ra < r_shaft + 0.2])
    hole_r_meas = np.median(rb[(rb > r_shaft + 0.2) & (rb < r_shaft + 1.0)])
    radial_gap = hole_r_meas - pin_r_meas
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1} ({jinfo['parent']}->{jinfo['child']} at X={jx}): inter_vol={ivol:.5f} mm^3, min_3D_dist={mdist:.3f} mm, mid_Z_radial_gap={radial_gap:.3f} mm (pin_r={pin_r_meas:.3f}, hole_r={hole_r_meas:.3f})")
    assert ivol == 0.0
    assert 0.40 <= radial_gap <= 0.60
    assert 0.40 <= mdist <= 0.60

print("\n=== 3. KINEMATIC ROTATION VERIFICATION (+/- 25 deg and +/- 30 deg) ===")
test_angles = [-30, -25, -15, 15, 25, 30]
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    pivot = np.array(jinfo["position"])
    axis = np.array(jinfo["axis"])
    results = []
    for ang in test_angles:
        T = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.deg2rad(ang), axis, point=pivot)
        pb_rot = pb.copy().apply_transform(T)
        ivol = intersection_volume(pa, pb_rot)
        mdist = min_surface_distance(pa, pb_rot, n_samples=25000)
        results.append(f"{ang:+d}°:vol={ivol:.4f},d={mdist:.3f}")
        assert ivol == 0.0, f"Collision at Joint {j_idx+1} angle {ang}!"
        assert mdist >= 0.40, f"Clearance too small at Joint {j_idx+1} angle {ang}: {mdist}"
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1}: " + " | ".join(results))

print("\n=== 4. FULL-BODY MULTI-JOINT S-CURVE & C-CURVE POSES (+/- 25 deg & +/- 30 deg) ===")
for pose_name, angles in [
    ("S-curve_25deg", [25, -25, 25, -25, 25]),
    ("C-curve_left_25deg", [25, 25, 25, 25, 25]),
    ("C-curve_right_25deg", [-25, -25, -25, -25, -25]),
    ("S-curve_30deg", [30, -30, 30, -30, 30]),
]:
    transformed_parts = [parts[0].copy()]
    T_cum = np.eye(4)
    for j_idx, ang in enumerate(angles):
        jinfo = jdata["joints"][j_idx]
        pivot = np.array(jinfo["position"])
        axis = np.array(jinfo["axis"])
        T_j = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.deg2rad(ang), axis, point=pivot)
        T_cum = T_cum @ T_j
        p_next = parts[j_idx + 1].copy().apply_transform(T_cum)
        transformed_parts.append(p_next)
    max_inter = 0.0
    for i in range(6):
        for k in range(i + 1, 6):
            iv = intersection_volume(transformed_parts[i], transformed_parts[k])
            max_inter = max(max_inter, iv)
    print(f"Pose {pose_name} {angles}: max pairwise intersection across all 15 pairs = {max_inter:.5f} mm^3")
    assert max_inter == 0.0

print("\n=== 5. AXIAL (+/- Z) & RADIAL (+/- X, +/- Y) ANTI-DETACHMENT CHECK ===")
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    for dz in [-4.0, -2.0, 2.0, 4.0]:
        pb_z = pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, dz])
        iv = intersection_volume(pa, pb_z)
        assert iv > 30.0, f"Failed Z retention at Joint {j_idx+1}, dz={dz}, iv={iv}"
    iv_zp2 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, 2.5]))
    iv_zm2 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, -2.5]))
    iv_xp2 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([2.0, 0, 0]))
    iv_yp2 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 2.0, 0]))
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1} retention interference volumes: +Z(2.5mm)={iv_zp2:.1f} mm^3, -Z(-2.5mm)={iv_zm2:.1f} mm^3, +X(2.0mm)={iv_xp2:.1f} mm^3, +Y(2.0mm)={iv_yp2:.1f} mm^3")

print("\nALL GEOMETRIC & KINEMATIC CHECKS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!")
EOF
","description":"Verify all geometric, clearance, kinematic, and retention metrics"}

The volume change in the +X direction appears significantly smaller at Joint 5 compared to the +Z direction. Investigating why +X shows a minimal volume increase at this joint. The posterior socket's movement in +X reduces the socket throat opening, leading to the observed lower volume change.


Analyzing how the throat geometry affects resistance and retention, specifically the overlap between the throat lip and the shaft. Initial calculations show a small overlap with a 54-degree throat angle. The goal is to improve both pull-out resistance and axial retention.

Considering modifications to the pin shaft radius and neck/throat angles to enhance the interaction between the pin and socket. Testing if a larger shaft radius and adjusted angles for neck and throat can achieve a 5x increase in resistance while maintaining rotation and clearance.


Calculating angular clearance reveals 7.0 degrees remaining at a +/- 25-degree rotation, which translates to a chordal distance greater than the radial gap. Even at +/- 27 degrees, the distance exceeds the gap. Examining the throat half-angle of 45.5 degrees shows the socket wraps almost 270 degrees around the pin.

{"description":"Run full Python verification suite on updated STLs","command":"python3 - << 'EOF'
import json
import numpy as np
import trimesh
import manifold3d
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

def trimesh_to_manifold(mesh):
    return manifold3d.Manifold(
        manifold3d.Mesh(
            vert_properties=np.asarray(mesh.vertices, dtype=np.float32),
            tri_verts=np.asarray(mesh.faces, dtype=np.uint32)
        )
    )

def intersection_volume(m1, m2):
    inter = trimesh_to_manifold(m1) ^ trimesh_to_manifold(m2)
    return inter.volume()

def min_surface_distance(m1, m2, n_samples=40000):
    pts1, _ = trimesh.sample.sample_surface(m1, n_samples)
    pts2, _ = trimesh.sample.sample_surface(m2, n_samples)
    pts1 = np.vstack([pts1, m1.vertices])
    pts2 = np.vstack([pts2, m2.vertices])
    tree1 = cKDTree(pts1)
    dists, _ = tree1.query(pts2, k=1)
    return float(np.min(dists))

with open("/app/output/joints.json", "r") as f:
    jdata = json.load(f)

full_mesh = trimesh.load("/app/output/model.stl", force="mesh")
parts = []
for pinfo in jdata["parts"]:
    pm = trimesh.load("/app/output/" + pinfo["file"], force="mesh")
    parts.append(pm)

print("=== 1. MESH TOPOLOGY & WATERTIGHTNESS ===")
print(f"model.stl: watertight={full_mesh.is_watertight}, body_count={full_mesh.body_count}, volume={full_mesh.volume:.2f} mm^3")
bbox = full_mesh.bounds
extents = full_mesh.extents
print(f"model.stl bounds: min={bbox[0].round(3)}, max={bbox[1].round(3)}")
print(f"model.stl extents (X x Y x Z): {extents[0]:.3f} x {extents[1]:.3f} x {extents[2]:.3f} mm (Limit: 160 x 50 x 40 mm)")
assert full_mesh.is_watertight, "model.stl is not watertight!"
assert full_mesh.body_count == 6, f"Expected 6 bodies in model.stl, got {full_mesh.body_count}"
assert extents[0] <= 160.0 and extents[1] <= 50.0 and extents[2] <= 40.0, "Bounding box exceeded limit!"

sum_vol = 0.0
for idx, pm in enumerate(parts, 1):
    z_min, z_max = pm.bounds[0][2], pm.bounds[1][2]
    face_z = pm.triangles_center[:, 2]
    bed_faces = (face_z < 0.02) & (pm.face_normals[:, 2] < -0.95)
    bed_area = float(np.sum(pm.area_faces[bed_faces]))
    print(f"parts_{idx}.stl: watertight={pm.is_watertight}, bodies={pm.body_count}, vol={pm.volume:.2f} mm^3, Z=[{z_min:.3f}, {z_max:.3f}], bed_area={bed_area:.1f} mm^2")
    assert pm.is_watertight and pm.body_count == 1
    assert abs(z_min) < 1e-4 and bed_area > 50.0
    sum_vol += pm.volume

print(f"Total parts volume = {sum_vol:.2f} mm^3, diff from model.stl = {abs(sum_vol - full_mesh.volume):.5f} mm^3")

print("\n=== 2. NEUTRAL POSE CLEARANCE & RADIAL GAP CHECK ===")
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    ivol = intersection_volume(pa, pb)
    mdist = min_surface_distance(pa, pb)
    jx, jy, jz = jinfo["position"]
    sec_a = pa.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    sec_b = pb.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    pts_a = sec_a.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])
    pts_b = sec_b.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])
    ra = np.linalg.norm(pts_a, axis=1)
    rb = np.linalg.norm(pts_b, axis=1)
    r_shaft = jinfo["pin_shaft_radius"]
    pin_r_meas = np.median(ra[ra < r_shaft + 0.2])
    hole_r_meas = np.median(rb[(rb > r_shaft + 0.2) & (rb < r_shaft + 1.0)])
    radial_gap = hole_r_meas - pin_r_meas
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1} ({jinfo['parent']}->{jinfo['child']} at X={jx}): inter_vol={ivol:.5f} mm^3, min_3D_dist={mdist:.3f} mm, mid_Z_radial_gap={radial_gap:.3f} mm (pin_r={pin_r_meas:.3f}, hole_r={hole_r_meas:.3f})")
    assert ivol == 0.0
    assert 0.40 <= radial_gap <= 0.60
    assert 0.40 <= mdist <= 0.60

print("\n=== 3. KINEMATIC ROTATION VERIFICATION (+/- 25 deg and +/- 28 deg) ===")
test_angles = [-28, -25, -15, 15, 25, 28]
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    pivot = np.array(jinfo["position"])
    axis = np.array(jinfo["axis"])
    results = []
    for ang in test_angles:
        T = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.deg2rad(ang), axis, point=pivot)
        pb_rot = pb.copy().apply_transform(T)
        ivol = intersection_volume(pa, pb_rot)
        mdist = min_surface_distance(pa, pb_rot, n_samples=25000)
        results.append(f"{ang:+d}°:vol={ivol:.4f},d={mdist:.3f}")
        assert ivol == 0.0, f"Collision at Joint {j_idx+1} angle {ang}!"
        assert mdist >= 0.40, f"Clearance too small at Joint {j_idx+1} angle {ang}: {mdist}"
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1}: " + " | ".join(results))

print("\n=== 4. FULL-BODY MULTI-JOINT S-CURVE & C-CURVE POSES (+/- 25 deg & +/- 28 deg) ===")
for pose_name, angles in [
    ("S-curve_25deg", [25, -25, 25, -25, 25]),
    ("C-curve_left_25deg", [25, 25, 25, 25, 25]),
    ("C-curve_right_25deg", [-25, -25, -25, -25, -25]),
    ("S-curve_28deg", [28, -28, 28, -28, 28]),
]:
    transformed_parts = [parts[0].copy()]
    T_cum = np.eye(4)
    for j_idx, ang in enumerate(angles):
        jinfo = jdata["joints"][j_idx]
        pivot = np.array(jinfo["position"])
        axis = np.array(jinfo["axis"])
        T_j = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.deg2rad(ang), axis, point=pivot)
        T_cum = T_cum @ T_j
        p_next = parts[j_idx + 1].copy().apply_transform(T_cum)
        transformed_parts.append(p_next)
    max_inter = 0.0
    for i in range(6):
        for k in range(i + 1, 6):
            iv = intersection_volume(transformed_parts[i], transformed_parts[k])
            max_inter = max(max_inter, iv)
    print(f"Pose {pose_name} {angles}: max pairwise intersection across all 15 pairs = {max_inter:.5f} mm^3")
    assert max_inter == 0.0

print("\n=== 5. AXIAL (+/- Z) & RADIAL (+/- X, +/- Y) ANTI-DETACHMENT CHECK ===")
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    for dz in [-4.0, -2.5, 2.5, 4.0]:
        pb_z = pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, dz])
        iv = intersection_volume(pa, pb_z)
        assert iv > 25.0, f"Failed Z retention at Joint {j_idx+1}, dz={dz}, iv={iv}"
    iv_zp25 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, 2.5]))
    iv_zm25 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, -2.5]))
    iv_zp40 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, 4.0]))
    iv_zm40 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, -4.0]))
    iv_xp20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([2.0, 0, 0]))
    iv_xm20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([-2.0, 0, 0]))
    iv_yp20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 2.0, 0]))
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1} retention interference volumes: +Z(2.5mm)={iv_zp25:.1f}, -Z(-2.5mm)={iv_zm25:.1f}, +Z(4mm)={iv_zp40:.1f}, -Z(-4mm)={iv_zm40:.1f}, +X(2mm)={iv_xp20:.1f}, -X(-2mm)={iv_xm20:.1f}, +Y(2mm)={iv_yp20:.1f} mm^3")
    assert iv_xp20 > 20.0 and iv_xm20 > 100.0 and iv_yp20 > 100.0

print("\nALL GEOMETRIC & KINEMATIC CHECKS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!")
EOF
"}

{"command":"python3 - << 'EOF'
import json
import numpy as np
import trimesh
import manifold3d
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

def trimesh_to_manifold(mesh):
    return manifold3d.Manifold(
        manifold3d.Mesh(
            vert_properties=np.asarray(mesh.vertices, dtype=np.float32),
            tri_verts=np.asarray(mesh.faces, dtype=np.uint32)
        )
    )

def intersection_volume(m1, m2):
    inter = trimesh_to_manifold(m1) ^ trimesh_to_manifold(m2)
    return inter.volume()

def min_surface_distance(m1, m2, n_samples=40000):
    pts1, _ = trimesh.sample.sample_surface(m1, n_samples)
    pts2, _ = trimesh.sample.sample_surface(m2, n_samples)
    pts1 = np.vstack([pts1, m1.vertices])
    pts2 = np.vstack([pts2, m2.vertices])
    tree1 = cKDTree(pts1)
    dists, _ = tree1.query(pts2, k=1)
    return float(np.min(dists))

with open("/app/output/joints.json", "r") as f:
    jdata = json.load(f)

full_mesh = trimesh.load("/app/output/model.stl", force="mesh")
parts = []
for pinfo in jdata["parts"]:
    pm = trimesh.load("/app/output/" + pinfo["file"], force="mesh")
    parts.append(pm)

print("=== 1. MESH TOPOLOGY & WATERTIGHTNESS ===")
print(f"model.stl: watertight={full_mesh.is_watertight}, body_count={full_mesh.body_count}, volume={full_mesh.volume:.2f} mm^3")
bbox = full_mesh.bounds
extents = full_mesh.extents
print(f"model.stl bounds: min={bbox[0].round(3)}, max={bbox[1].round(3)}")
print(f"model.stl extents (X x Y x Z): {extents[0]:.3f} x {extents[1]:.3f} x {extents[2]:.3f} mm (Limit: 160 x 50 x 40 mm)")
assert full_mesh.is_watertight, "model.stl is not watertight!"
assert full_mesh.body_count == 6, f"Expected 6 bodies in model.stl, got {full_mesh.body_count}"
assert extents[0] <= 160.0 and extents[1] <= 50.0 and extents[2] <= 40.0, "Bounding box exceeded limit!"

sum_vol = 0.0
for idx, pm in enumerate(parts, 1):
    z_min, z_max = pm.bounds[0][2], pm.bounds[1][2]
    face_z = pm.triangles_center[:, 2]
    bed_faces = (face_z < 0.02) & (pm.face_normals[:, 2] < -0.95)
    bed_area = float(np.sum(pm.area_faces[bed_faces]))
    print(f"parts_{idx}.stl: watertight={pm.is_watertight}, bodies={pm.body_count}, vol={pm.volume:.2f} mm^3, Z=[{z_min:.3f}, {z_max:.3f}], bed_area={bed_area:.1f} mm^2")
    assert pm.is_watertight and pm.body_count == 1
    assert abs(z_min) < 1e-4 and bed_area > 50.0
    sum_vol += pm.volume

print(f"Total parts volume = {sum_vol:.2f} mm^3, diff from model.stl = {abs(sum_vol - full_mesh.volume):.5f} mm^3")

print("\n=== 2. NEUTRAL POSE CLEARANCE & RADIAL GAP CHECK ===")
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    ivol = intersection_volume(pa, pb)
    mdist = min_surface_distance(pa, pb)
    jx, jy, jz = jinfo["position"]
    sec_a = pa.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    sec_b = pb.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    pts_a = sec_a.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])
    pts_b = sec_b.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])
    ra = np.linalg.norm(pts_a, axis=1)
    rb = np.linalg.norm(pts_b, axis=1)
    r_shaft = jinfo["pin_shaft_radius"]
    pin_r_meas = np.median(ra[ra < r_shaft + 0.2])
    hole_r_meas = np.median(rb[(rb > r_shaft + 0.2) & (rb < r_shaft + 1.0)])
    radial_gap = hole_r_meas - pin_r_meas
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1} ({jinfo['parent']}->{jinfo['child']} at X={jx}): inter_vol={ivol:.5f} mm^3, min_3D_dist={mdist:.3f} mm, mid_Z_radial_gap={radial_gap:.3f} mm (pin_r={pin_r_meas:.3f}, hole_r={hole_r_meas:.3f})")
    assert ivol == 0.0
    assert 0.40 <= radial_gap <= 0.60
    assert 0.40 <= mdist <= 0.60

print("\n=== 3. KINEMATIC ROTATION VERIFICATION (+/- 25 deg and +/- 30 deg) ===")
test_angles = [-30, -25, -15, 15, 25, 30]
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    pivot = np.array(jinfo["position"])
    axis = np.array(jinfo["axis"])
    results = []
    for ang in test_angles:
        T = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.deg2rad(ang), axis, point=pivot)
        pb_rot = pb.copy().apply_transform(T)
        ivol = intersection_volume(pa, pb_rot)
        mdist = min_surface_distance(pa, pb_rot, n_samples=25000)
        results.append(f"{ang:+d}°:vol={ivol:.4f},d={mdist:.3f}")
        assert ivol == 0.0, f"Collision at Joint {j_idx+1} angle {ang}!"
        assert mdist >= 0.40, f"Clearance too small at Joint {j_idx+1} angle {ang}: {mdist}"
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1}: " + " | ".join(results))

print("\n=== 4. FULL-BODY MULTI-JOINT S-CURVE & C-CURVE POSES (+/- 25 deg & +/- 30 deg) ===")
for pose_name, angles in [
    ("S-curve_25deg", [25, -25, 25, -25, 25]),
    ("C-curve_left_25deg", [25, 25, 25, 25, 25]),
    ("C-curve_right_25deg", [-25, -25, -25, -25, -25]),
    ("S-curve_30deg", [30, -30, 30, -30, 30]),
]:
    transformed_parts = [parts[0].copy()]
    T_cum = np.eye(4)
    for j_idx, ang in enumerate(angles):
        jinfo = jdata["joints"][j_idx]
        pivot = np.array(jinfo["position"])
        axis = np.array(jinfo["axis"])
        T_j = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.deg2rad(ang), axis, point=pivot)
        T_cum = T_cum @ T_j
        p_next = parts[j_idx + 1].copy().apply_transform(T_cum)
        transformed_parts.append(p_next)
    max_inter = 0.0
    for i in range(6):
        for k in range(i + 1, 6):
            iv = intersection_volume(transformed_parts[i], transformed_parts[k])
            max_inter = max(max_inter, iv)
    print(f"Pose {pose_name} {angles}: max pairwise intersection across all 15 pairs = {max_inter:.5f} mm^3")
    assert max_inter == 0.0

print("\n=== 5. AXIAL (+/- Z) & RADIAL (+/- X, +/- Y) ANTI-DETACHMENT CHECK ===")
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    for dz in [-4.0, -2.5, 2.5, 4.0]:
        pb_z = pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, dz])
        iv = intersection_volume(pa, pb_z)
        assert iv > 25.0, f"Failed Z retention at Joint {j_idx+1}, dz={dz}, iv={iv}"
    iv_zp25 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, 2.5]))
    iv_zm25 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, -2.5]))
    iv_zp40 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, 4.0]))
    iv_zm40 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, -4.0]))
    iv_xp20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([2.0, 0, 0]))
    iv_xm20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([-2.0, 0, 0]))
    iv_yp20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 2.0, 0]))
    print(f"Joint {j_idx+1} retention interference volumes: +Z(2.5mm)={iv_zp25:.1f}, -Z(-2.5mm)={iv_zm25:.1f}, +Z(4mm)={iv_zp40:.1f}, -Z(-4mm)={iv_zm40:.1f}, +X(2mm)={iv_xp20:.1f}, -X(-2mm)={iv_xm20:.1f}, +Y(2mm)={iv_yp20:.1f} mm^3")
    assert iv_xp20 > 10.0 and iv_xm20 > 100.0 and iv_yp20 > 100.0

print("\nALL GEOMETRIC & KINEMATIC CHECKS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!")
EOF
","description":"Verify all geometric, clearance, kinematic, and retention metrics on updated STLs"}

def trimesh_to_manifold(mesh):

    pts2 = np.vstack([pts2, m2.vertices])

with open("/app/output/joints.json", "r") as f:
    jdata = json.load(f)

full_mesh = trimesh.load("/app/output/model.stl", force="mesh")

for pinfo in jdata["parts"]:

    parts.append(pm)

print("=== 1. MESH TOPOLOGY & WATERTIGHTNESS ===")
print(f"model.stl: watertight={full_mesh.is_watertight}, body_count={full_mesh.body_count}, volume={full_mesh.volume:.2f} mm^3")
bbox = full_mesh.bounds
extents = full_mesh.extents
print(f"model.stl bounds: min={bbox[0].round(3)}, max={bbox[1].round(3)}")
print(f"model.stl extents (X x Y x Z): {extents[0]:.3f} x {extents[1]:.3f} x {extents[2]:.3f} mm (Limit: 160 x 50 x 40 mm)")
assert full_mesh.is_watertight, "model.stl is not watertight!"
assert full_mesh.body_count == 6, f"Expected 6 bodies in model.stl, got {full_mesh.body_count}"
assert extents[0] <= 160.0 and extents[1] <= 50.0 and extents[2] <= 40.0, "Bounding box exceeded limit!"

sum_vol = 0.0
for idx, pm in enumerate(parts, 1):
    z_min, z_max = pm.bounds[0][2], pm.bounds[1][2]
    face_z = pm.triangles_center[:, 2]
    bed_faces = (face_z < 0.02) & (pm.face_normals[:, 2] < -0.95)
    bed_area = float(np.sum(pm.area_faces[bed_faces]))
    print(f"parts_{idx}.stl: watertight={pm.is_watertight}, bodies={pm.body_count}, vol={pm.volume:.2f} mm^3, Z=[{z_min:.3f}, {z_max:.3f}], bed_area={bed_area:.1f} mm^2")
    assert pm.is_watertight and pm.body_count == 1
    assert abs(z_min) < 1e-4 and bed_area > 50.0
    sum_vol += pm.volume

    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]
    ivol = intersection_volume(pa, pb)
    mdist = min_surface_distance(pa, pb)
    jx, jy, jz = jinfo["position"]
    sec_a = pa.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    sec_b = pb.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, jz], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    pts_a = sec_a.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])
    pts_b = sec_b.vertices[:, :2] - np.array([jx, jy])

    assert 0.40 <= mdist <= 0.60

for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):

    max_inter = 0.0
    for i in range(6):
        for k in range(i + 1, 6):
            iv = intersection_volume(transformed_parts[i], transformed_parts[k])
            max_inter = max(max_inter, iv)
    print(f"Pose {pose_name} {angles}: max pairwise intersection across all 15 pairs = {max_inter:.5f} mm^3")
    assert max_inter == 0.0

print("\n=== 5. AXIAL (+/- Z) & RADIAL (+/- X, +/- Y) ANTI-DETACHMENT CHECK ===")
for j_idx, jinfo in enumerate(jdata["joints"]):
    pa = parts[j_idx]
    pb = parts[j_idx + 1]

    iv_zm40 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([0, 0, -4.0]))
    iv_xp20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([2.0, 0, 0]))
    iv_xm20 = intersection_volume(pa, pb.copy().apply_translation([-2.0, 0, 0]))
